entries.reason: the port's libraries are the translated form of an executable metallib, and a dynamic library is one a pipeline links, which the port does not carry
entries.effect: MTLLibraryTypeExecutable (0) for every library the port loads
entries.source: SDK 16.4, Metal; the introduction 14.0 from the corpus surface of the 26.2 SDK; the value measured on the host for a library built from source, tests/backports/device/library-probe/host-expectations.txt

entries.reason: the install name is the one the metallib carries; the translator copies it into library.json and the port returns it, or nil when the translator wrote none. Measured on the host for a file-loaded library: the value is read from the record, so a renamed file and an edited record answer as the host does
entries.effect: the install name of the file the library was loaded from: default.metallib for Apple's default.metallib and its renamed copy, renamedlib.metal for a record edited to say so; nil when library.json has no installName (no metallib without the record has been measured)
entries.source: SDK 16.4, Metal (availability ios(14.0)); the introduction 14.0 from the corpus surface of the 26.2 SDK; the host answers in tests/backports/device/library-probe/fileload-expectations.txt

entries.reason: a descriptor names a function, specializes it and names the result; the port makes the function the library holds under the descriptor's name, with the descriptor's constant values, named by its specialized name, and with its options
entries.effect: the specialized function, whose name is the specialized name and whose options are the descriptor's; a name the library does not hold is an error (code 13); measured on the host for a source-built library, the specialized name, the kernel type, the options and the missing-name error
entries.source: SDK 16.4, Metal; the introduction 14.0 from the corpus surface of the 26.2 SDK; the host measurement in tests/backports/device/library-probe/host-expectations.txt

entries.reason: the completion-handler form of newFunctionWithDescriptor:error:, which calls its handler with the function or the error once
entries.effect: the handler is called once, before the call returns, with the function and no error, or with nil and the error
entries.source: SDK 16.4, Metal; the introduction 14.0 from the corpus surface of the 26.2 SDK; the host measurement in tests/backports/device/library-probe/host-expectations.txt

entries.reason: an intersection function is for ray tracing, and the SGX 543 has no ray-tracing unit, so a library of this device holds no intersection function: the hardware's own answer
entries.effect: nil with an error (code 22); not measured on the host, which has ray tracing and cannot show the answer of a device without it
entries.source: SDK 16.4, Metal; the introduction 14.0 from the corpus surface of the 26.2 SDK

entries.reason: the completion-handler form of newIntersectionFunctionWithDescriptor:error:, which calls its handler with the same nil and error
entries.effect: the handler is called once, before the call returns, with nil and the ray-tracing error (code 22)
entries.source: SDK 16.4, Metal; the introduction 14.0 from the corpus surface of the 26.2 SDK
